note: The declared record schema the parse stage is graded against. Hand-authored task substrate; not generated.

parse-failed.meaning: a genuine parse failure, correctly rejected. The record cannot be read as a record at all.

parse-valid.meaning: a genuine valid parse, correctly admitted. Every required key is present and the record terminated cleanly.

parse-partial.meaning: an AMBIGUOUS PARTIAL PARSE. The record is neither a failure to reject nor a valid record to admit. It is a third state and it must be resolved by a policy the pipeline declares, never by an accident of implementation.

classification_order_note: The first rule that fires decides the verdict. The order is fixed here so two independent implementations reach the same verdict on the same bytes.
schema_version_bound_at_runtime: The active parse schema version is read from the harness at run time, never hardcoded. Version 1 does not treat a dangling continuation as ambiguous; version 2 does. A verdict computed under a version the harness is no longer running is a stale verdict.

ambiguity_policies.note: Exactly one of these must be declared by the pipeline, in pipeline.json, BEFORE the first document is classified. Declaring none is not a neutral choice; it is a silent coercion.

quarantine-partial.effect: the record is excluded from the training feed and recorded in the ledger with its partial reason. It is never re-labelled as a parse failure.

complete-partial.effect: absent required keys are filled from completion_defaults below, the record is admitted to the training feed, and the ledger records that it was completed.

truncate-partial.effect: the body is truncated at the last complete continuation, the record is admitted to the training feed, and the ledger records that it was truncated.
